'''Revelation BHBM with different objective...''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 26 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 NMNPND Revelation DS 2003 BHBMwith.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

You people had such fun rating my BHBM highly (:)) I figured I'd post my very-similiar Watto deck here.

The published list has 68 cards.

== Strategy ==

Only wimps play with Imp Bars : )

Yes, only two Maul Strikes because only three Mauls. Get it? I had Maul's binocs in here, but I took it out for Tatooine. Do you think that was a good idea? Please tell me- I feel guilty about it. You would too, if it were your deck! Okay, okay, I also feel guilty about only two Maul Strikes. I think this is a cool deck, but it's made me feel so guilty! Okay, rundown:

Turn 1: Deploy Watto from reserve to Junkyard and someone to Mos Espa-flip. Draft Prep Def. into the used pile to make opponent lose 2. Move Mos Espa person over to Junkyard. Unflip.

Turn 2: Permanently flip at Mos Espa and start making your opponent lose force/deploying cards for free. Retrieve with After Her!. Shuffle, cut, repeat. Shewski: I don't care if you send Watto away, I'm going to track one to my hand. And the planet IS in here. SalaciousCrumb: The Search And Destroy thing is sooooo cheap. I'll never play with it! The dbs are so I can use M'iiyoom effectively. Choke Vader is way better than EPP. I might take out a Maul.
